annotations.title: Report a result that looks wrong

description: REPORT a NoData result that looks wrong, tied to the event it is about, and follow it. action:'file' (default) files a report: `kind` (not_found = something sensitive was there and nothing was reported; found_wrongly; wrong_class; not_read; read_partly; type_unsupported; decision_mismatch; other), `subject_kind` + `subject_ref` (a receipt id, a scan or gate summary proof id, or the file's SHA-256: results print a 'Looks wrong?' line with these filled in), and the user's own words for: expected (what they expected it to find or decide), observed (what it found or decided), should_have, instead, layer (detection, decoding, classification, enforcement, not_sure). Send only what the user said; never guess for them. NEVER put content, a value, a key or a file in it: the door refuses attachments and anything shaped like a key or a card number. If NoData needs a sample it asks for a made-up one through the secure channel. action:'status' lists the organisation's reports with their history, or one by `reference` (RR-XXXXXX). action:'reply' adds the user's words to a report's thread. Only a person in the console marks a fix verified or closes it; this tool cannot.

expected.description: What the user expected it to find or decide

layer.description: Where the user thinks it went wrong

reference.description: The report's reference, RR-XXXXXX (action:status or reply)

subject_ref.description: Its id or fingerprint, as the result printed it (action:file)
